description: A draft adds a consultation of the AI lead to the configuration change group. A consultation never counts, but the counting rule that names the configuration admin role stays in the group, so a configuration admin still accepts both configuration decision types and V32 passes.
$comment: Until the engine check role.config-admin was built, this case added a second role with Can Change Configuration. That case now fails role.config-admin (see role-config-admin-second-role), so this one keeps V32's passing side without it.
